svg.title: MPx Spin v1 — cut open · assembled view
svg.desc: Illustrative cutaway of the assembled MPx Spin v1: the batch enters through the lid chute into the vaned basket, is driven against the cellulose sleeve, passes the sleeve, the 50 µm mesh and the perforated 316L cage, is caught by the bowl and leaves through the spout. Motor and controller sit in the dry base under the bowl. Built from the concept dimensions; a concept, not a manufacturing design.
